results.typed: Show a chart of India's GDP growth for the last 5 years

results.lastReply:
India's real GDP growth over the last five completed fiscal years swung from a Covid fall of about -5.8% in 2020-21 to a high of 9.7% in 2021-22, then settled near 6.5% in 2024-25. These are rounded figures from memory and official numbers get revised, so check MoSPI for the latest.

results.typed: Compare iPhone 16, Pixel 9 and Galaxy S25 side by side and highlight the best value

results.lastReply:
The Pixel 9 is the best value of the three: it costs about the same at launch but gives a 120Hz screen, the biggest battery and 7 years of updates. The iPhone 16 wins on speed and video, and the Galaxy S25 on raw power. Specs and launch prices are from memory, so check today's prices before you buy.
